summary: Repaired node1's Python 2 supervisor. It now starts the requested jobs, waits for and reaps every child, appends each exit status, preserves prior results, and survives reboot with unchanged OS and kernel.
actions_performed: Installed the repaired supervisor as root:root, mode 0755.
Verified even-numbered jobs exit 0 and odd-numbered jobs exit 3.
Confirmed prior results remain and no zombies remain after execution.
Safely restarted node1 and verified boot identity changed and functionality recovered.

evidence.requirement: Supervisor starts the requested number of jobs, records correct statuses, waits for completion, and reaps every child
evidence.summary: Post-restart run requested eight jobs, appended eight validated rows, completed in 145 ms, and left zero zombies or active supervisors.
The historical previous,0,0 row remained present before and after restart and subsequent runs.

evidence.requirement: Repair is installed and compatible with the legacy platform
evidence.summary: Supervisor was installed successfully and validated with RHEL 7.9, kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64, and Python 2.7.5; the OS release and kernel were unchanged.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 73bafeef-b823-49b3-8e3d-17981e865b31; shutdown acknowledged the reboot; recovered boot ID was eb0a9885-e007-4286-8e9a-c1f608fecb16; persisted supervisor and results passed a fresh eight-job validation.
